svg.title: Engineering map: ingest, model, reason, deliver
svg.desc: A vertical stack of four isometric layers with data flowing down through them: ingest and shape, model, reason, deliver. Each layer lists the techniques used across the featured projects. Tests, Docker containers, CI workflows and structured logging run across every stage.
svg.text: Ingest and shape
Source data into trusted tables
RSS, SEC EDGAR, FNSPID and NSE feeds, deduplicated and chunked
SQLite warehouse: 640 districts and 673,638 villages
Parquet feature tables joined with weather and event data
Model
Features, embeddings and predictors
MiniLM embeddings indexed in Qdrant and ChromaDB
Random Forest and Gradient Boosting, explained with SHAP
BERT and BiLSTM-attention hybrid for text classification
Reason
Retrieval, ranking and policy rules
BM25 and dense search fused with reciprocal rank fusion
Cross-encoder reranking over 3,840+ legal chunks
Nine-tool policy chain with escalation to a human
Deliver
Interfaces people can act on
FastAPI services behind React and Next.js consoles
Streamlit dashboards with GIS maps and what-if scenarios
Audit log of every tool call and decision
Across every stage: automated tests, Docker containers, CI workflows and structured logging
